title: The 8 Levels of Three-Year Dating
house: Freshville, a neon-lit metropolis where produce-people navigate modern romance under the harsh glow of their glowing forehead numbers, sharing narrow apartments, 24-hour diners, and subway platforms.
catchphrase: The number on your forehead never lies.

levels.name: Maya, 26, Barista
levels.story: 2.000 Euro für eine billige Mikrowelle? Wer hat Leo eigentlich reingelassen? Vielleicht putzt er gleich die Toiletten für uns Erfolgreiche. Month 36. Three years of renting a damp studio together, and my forehead badge still flashes Month 36 with zero ring in sight. I stood across from Leo at our cramped kitchen table, holding a lukewarm cup of instant coffee, waiting for the question every couple faces. Instead, he didn't even look up from his phone screen. He just swiped right on another dating app while sitting right in front of me. I slammed my ceramic mug down so hard the handle snapped off, spilling dark liquid across the cheap laminate counter. How can we celebrate three years when you are already shopping for someone else? You are just a placeholder until I upgrade my apartment. Das siehst du in Level 2. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Leo, 28, Delivery Driver
levels.story: Nach vier Jahren ziehst du aus und nimmst nicht mal deinen Schrott mit? Du bist keine Partnerin, du bist ein mietfreier Schmarotzer! Four years of dating, and my forehead badge finally ticked up while Maya was packing her cardboard boxes in the hallway. I stood by the door holding my gym bag, listening to her sniffle while she zipped up her old duffel bag. You think you deserve a ring when you cannot even pay half the Wi-Fi bill? She looked up at me with red, watery eyes, her strawberry skin pale with utter disbelief. After four years, that is all I am worth to you? You made the right trade today, kid. Das siehst du in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Chloe, 29, Accountant
levels.story: Einen Ehevertrag nach drei Jahren? Wer ist dieser Mann, ein Anwalt oder ein Psychopath? Year 3.2. Three years and two months of living in a shared brownstone, and my forehead badge flashed Year 3.2 while my boyfriend of three years handed me a legal prenup during breakfast. I choked on my organic avocado toast, staring at the bold black print across the glossy paper. You really expect me to sign away my future after three years of building this life together? Three years is a probationary period, Chloe, not a marriage certificate. My heart hammered against my ribs as I looked at the pen in my hand, knowing that signing meant losing everything I had saved. Sign now before the market crashes completely. Das siehst du in Level 4. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Sam, 31, Landscape Architect
levels.story: Vier Jahre Liebe und du wirfst mein Fotobuch in den Dreck, weil kein echter Klunker drauf ist? Such dir einen Goldgräber, ich bin raus! Year 4.0. Four years of quiet loyalty, and my forehead badge hit Year 4.0 while my girlfriend tossed my handmade anniversary photo album into the muddy park grass. I knelt down in the drizzle, carefully wiping damp dirt off the cover of the book I had spent three months binding by hand. After four years, you still bring me paper scrapbooks instead of a real diamond? I looked up at her, my sturdy broccoli florets soaked with cold rain, feeling a strange sense of absolute clarity wash over me. I built a career with my bare hands and spent every anniversary trying to prove my love to someone who only counts material assets. Some trees only grow when you cut the dead branches off. Das siehst du in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Marcus, 32, Investment Broker
levels.story: Fünf Jahre und du schnüffelst in meinen Konten rum? Du vertraust mir nicht mal den Wocheneinkauf an! Year 5. Five years of high-stakes dating, and my forehead badge shone a solid Year 5 while my partner and I stood inside our glass-walled penthouse overlooking the financial district. I tossed my car keys onto the Italian marble kitchen island next to a bottle of vintage champagne. After five years of managing our joint assets, you still check my personal bank account behind my back? Trust isn't a joint account, Marcus, it's an audit you keep failing every single quarter. My jaw tightened as I stared at the screen showing every transaction from our anniversary trip last weekend. Your portfolio is safe, but your heart is completely bankrupt. Das siehst du in Level 6. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Elena, 33, Art Curator

Exactly five years since our first date, and my forehead badge flashed Month 60 while I sat alone at a reserved table in an empty upscale art gallery. I traced the stem of a long-stemmed red rose, waiting for the man who promised he would finally propose tonight. After sixty months of playing the supportive partner while you built your collection, you send me a text message instead of showing up? I found someone whose number matches my future goals better than yours ever will. A cold wave of betrayal washed over me as I realized every single anniversary had been nothing more than a calculated investment strategy. Your exhibition has been canceled due to lack of interest. Das siehst du in Level 7. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Julian, 35, Estate Attorney
levels.story: Sieben Jahre ein aufgebautes Imperium und du willst alles zerstören wegen einer Meinungsverschiedenheit über unser Treuhandkonto? Unterschreib endlich und verschwinde aus meinem Blickfeld. Year 7.5. Seven and a half years of legal partnerships and domestic stability, and my forehead badge burned bright with Year 7.5 while my wife of seven years presented me with divorce papers across our study desk. I adjusted my gold-rimmed reading glasses, staring at the embossed seal stamped onto the front page of the legal binder. After seven and a half years of building this estate together, you want to dissolve everything over a disagreement about our trust fund? The merger is finalized, sign the papers and let her walk. My hands shook slightly as I held the pen, knowing that signing would divide an empire we spent nearly a decade constructing. Das siehst du in Level 8. You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: Elder Thorn, 70, Park Keeper
levels.story: Nach 50 Jahren Parkbank sehe ich euch alle scheitern, weil ihr eure Nummern mehr liebt als echte Menschen. Was für eine erbärmliche Bilanz. Forever. After watching thousands of couples walk through these park gates over the last fifty years, I finally understood what the numbers on our foreheads really meant. I sat on the old wooden bench where Maya and Leo had first shared a coffee on their very first date, watching the morning mist rise off the damp grass. A young couple walked past me, their forehead badges flashing Month 3 and Year 4 respectively, holding hands without a single care about what digits glowed above their eyes. True connection isn't measured in months, contracts, or bank accounts, I muttered to myself, gently tossing a small golden coin into the fountain beside the path. After seeing every level of love rise and fall in this city, I know that numbers only matter to those who forgot how to feel. What number is currently glowing on your own forehead right now?
